answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The vault holds work receipts rather than names, so the shale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
